role.en: Assistant Professor, CMU; Co-founder & Chief Scientist, Cartesia
role.zh: CMU 助理教授；Cartesia 联合创始人兼首席科学家

why.en: Principal author of S4 and Mamba, which provide the strongest alternative to the Transformer for sequence modelling — and the basis for Cartesia's real-time voice models.
why.zh: 状态空间模型 S4 与 Mamba 的主要作者，为 Transformer 之外的序列建模路线提供了最有力的替代方案 —— 也是 Cartesia 实时语音模型的基础。

title.en: Mamba-3 (with Tri Dao)
title.zh: Mamba-3（与 Tri Dao 合著）

title.en: chat with your model with a single identity across languages and accents!
title.zh: chat with your model with a single identity across languages and accents!

note.en: Gu highlighted Cartesia's voice model holding a single consistent identity across languages and accents.
note.zh: Gu介绍Cartesia的语音模型能够在不同语言和口音下保持同一身份的一致性。

title.en: misleading paper title, and even the phrasing in the tweet is still a misnomer. this is not about "post-training" but "retrofitting" (cross-architecture distill
title.zh: misleading paper title, and even the phrasing in the tweet is still a misnomer. this is not about "post-training" but "retrofitting" (cross-architecture distill

note.en: Gu pushed back on framing a cross-architecture distillation method as "post-training," calling it "retrofitting" instead and noting he's long been skeptical of distillation claims.
note.zh: Gu反驳了将一种跨架构蒸馏方法称为“后训练”的说法，认为应称之为“改造”，并表示他一直对蒸馏方面的说法持怀疑态度。

title.en: sonic-3.6 is out, with a large improvement over (the already #1) sonic-3.5 in just a few months! the research team's focus on fundamentals is accelerating progr
title.zh: sonic-3.6 is out, with a large improvement over (the already #1) sonic-3.5 in just a few months! the research team's focus on fundamentals is accelerating progr

note.en: Announced the release of Cartesia's Sonic-3.6 text-to-speech model, a significant upgrade over Sonic-3.5 within just a few months.
note.zh: 宣布Cartesia推出Sonic-3.6文本转语音模型，在短短几个月内相较Sonic-3.5实现重大提升。

title.en: the team continues cooking 👩‍🍳 this is now an unprecedented gap on both the super competitive Provider Voices leaderboard as well as the newer Controlled Voices
title.zh: the team continues cooking 👩‍🍳 this is now an unprecedented gap on both the super competitive Provider Voices leaderboard as well as the newer Controlled Voices

note.en: Reported that Cartesia's voice models opened an unprecedented lead on both the Provider Voices and Controlled Voices leaderboards.
note.zh: 报告称Cartesia的语音模型在Provider Voices和Controlled Voices两个排行榜上都取得了前所未有的领先优势。

title.en: Raven: High-Recall Sequence Modeling with Sparse Memory Routing
title.zh: Raven: High-Recall Sequence Modeling with Sparse Memory Routing

note.en: Sequence model that routes writes into sparse memory slots to improve long-context recall; Gu is senior author.
note.zh: 通过把写入路由到稀疏记忆槽来提升长上下文召回的序列模型，Gu 为通讯作者。

title.en: Evaluations are difficult and vague for all generative models, and benchmarks only capture a small slice. Our blog post dives into the nuances for TTS
title.zh: Evaluations are difficult and vague for all generative models, and benchmarks only capture a small slice. Our blog post dives into the nuances for TTS

note.en: Pointed to a Cartesia blog post arguing that TTS evaluation is inherently difficult and that benchmarks only capture a small slice of model quality.
note.zh: 转发Cartesia的一篇博客文章，指出TTS评测本质上很困难，基准测试只能反映模型质量的一小部分。

title.en: Transformers are better at copying, while RNNs are better at modeling "meaning-bearing words—the nouns, verbs, & adjectives that say what a sentence is abou
title.zh: Transformers are better at copying, while RNNs are better at modeling "meaning-bearing words—the nouns, verbs, & adjectives that say what a sentence is abou

note.en: Argued that Transformers excel at copying while RNN-style models are better at capturing the meaning-bearing words in a sentence.
note.zh: 指出Transformer更擅长复制信息，而RNN类模型更擅长捕捉句子中承载语义的关键词。

title.en: Rather than interleaving layers naively, a more fine-grained approach to hybrid models is to allow hybridization across the sequence models within a single laye
title.zh: Rather than interleaving layers naively, a more fine-grained approach to hybrid models is to allow hybridization across the sequence models within a single laye

note.en: Proposed a more fine-grained approach to hybrid sequence models that mixes attention and linear layers within a single layer rather than interleaving them naively.
note.zh: 提出一种更精细的混合序列模型设计思路，在单层内部混合注意力与线性层，而非简单地交替堆叠。

title.en: Within the span of a week, we launched streaming TTS (text-to-speech) and STT (speech-to-text) models that topped the leaderboards. I'm incredibly proud of the
title.zh: Within the span of a week, we launched streaming TTS (text-to-speech) and STT (speech-to-text) models that topped the leaderboards. I'm incredibly proud of the

note.en: Announced that Cartesia launched streaming TTS and STT models that topped their respective leaderboards within one week.
note.zh: 宣布Cartesia在一周内推出的流式TTS和STT模型双双登顶各自排行榜。

title.en: Our new model Ink-2 tops AA's leaderboard for streaming speech-to-text! Ink-2 comes with plenty of features optimized for real-time voice agents. With top-class
title.zh: Our new model Ink-2 tops AA's leaderboard for streaming speech-to-text! Ink-2 comes with plenty of features optimized for real-time voice agents. With top-class

note.en: Announced Cartesia's new streaming speech-to-text model Ink-2, which topped Artificial Analysis's leaderboard and is optimized for real-time voice agents.
note.zh: 宣布Cartesia推出新款流式语音转文本模型Ink-2，登顶Artificial Analysis排行榜，并针对实时语音助手做了优化。

title.en: Extremely proud of the team @cartesia for launching Sonic 3.5, which sets a new state of the art for TTS I personally led the technical direction of this model;
title.zh: Extremely proud of the team @cartesia for launching Sonic 3.5, which sets a new state of the art for TTS I personally led the technical direction of this model;

note.en: Announced Cartesia's Sonic 3.5 TTS model, setting a new state of the art, and said he personally led its technical direction.
note.zh: 宣布Cartesia的Sonic 3.5文本转语音模型创下新的技术纪录，并表示自己亲自主导了该模型的技术方向。

title.en: Introducing a new sequence model Raven which pushes the boundary of fixed-state-size sequence models! Raven bridges popular linear-time models with constant sta
title.zh: Introducing a new sequence model Raven which pushes the boundary of fixed-state-size sequence models! Raven bridges popular linear-time models with constant sta

note.en: Introduced Raven, a new sequence model bridging linear-time models like SSMs with sliding-window attention to push fixed-state-size architectures further.
note.zh: 推出新序列模型Raven，将SSM等线性时间模型与滑动窗口注意力相结合，推动固定状态规模架构的发展。

title.en: a dynamical systems point of view, which looks like an SSM applied along the residual stream, informs more principled ways to scale looped architectures
title.zh: a dynamical systems point of view, which looks like an SSM applied along the residual stream, informs more principled ways to scale looped architectures

note.en: Argued that viewing SSMs as dynamical systems applied along the residual stream offers a more principled way to scale looped architectures.
note.zh: 提出将SSM视为作用于残差流上的动力系统这一视角，可为扩展循环架构提供更有原则性的方法。

title.en: Raven Part-1 - Memory as a set of Slots
title.zh: Raven Part-1 - Memory as a set of Slots

note.en: Goomba Lab post introducing Raven, a recurrent architecture that holds memory as a set of addressable slots instead of one fixed-size state.
note.zh: Goomba Lab 博客，介绍 Raven 架构：将记忆表示为一组可寻址的槽位，而非单一固定大小的状态。

title.en: Raven Part-2 - Architecture and Results
title.zh: Raven Part-2 - Architecture and Results

note.en: Post on Gu's lab blog walking through the Raven architecture and its results.
note.zh: Gu 所在实验室博客上的文章，详细讲解 Raven 的架构与实验结果。

title.en: The newest model in the Mamba series is finally here 🐍 Hybrid models have become increasingly popular, raising the importance of designing the next generation o
title.zh: The newest model in the Mamba series is finally here 🐍 Hybrid models have become increasingly popular, raising the importance of designing the next generation o

note.en: Announced the newest Mamba model, introducing several advances for the next generation of linear/hybrid sequence models.
note.zh: 发布Mamba系列最新模型，为下一代线性/混合序列模型引入多项改进。

title.en: Mamba-3 Part 1
title.zh: Mamba-3 Part 1

note.en: Announces Mamba-3, the next iteration of the state-space architecture he originated, on his lab's blog.
note.zh: 在其实验室博客上发布 Mamba-3，即他所开创的状态空间架构的新一代版本。

title.en: Mamba-3 Part 2 - Methodological Deep Dive
title.zh: Mamba-3 Part 2 - Methodological Deep Dive

note.en: Second part of the Mamba-3 release, walking through the design choices behind the new architecture.
note.zh: Mamba-3 发布的第二部分，逐一解释新架构背后的设计取舍。

title.en: Mamba-3: Improved Sequence Modeling using State Space Principles
title.zh: Mamba-3: Improved Sequence Modeling using State Space Principles

note.en: Third generation of Gu's Mamba state-space architecture, retuned for inference efficiency.
note.zh: Gu 的 Mamba 状态空间架构第三代，针对推理效率重新设计。

title.en: as always, exciting to see NVIDIA continue to invest in Mamba hybrids and true open source. very impressive results!
title.zh: as always, exciting to see NVIDIA continue to invest in Mamba hybrids and true open source. very impressive results!

note.en: Praised NVIDIA's continued investment in Mamba hybrid architectures and open-source releases, calling the results impressive.
note.zh: 称赞NVIDIA持续投入Mamba混合架构和开源发布，认为其成果令人印象深刻。

title.en: okay this plot and discussion has blown up more than expected so let me try to leave some candid thoughts 1. i don't believe that the intent of Mayank's tweet w
title.zh: okay this plot and discussion has blown up more than expected so let me try to leave some candid thoughts 1. i don't believe that the intent of Mayank's tweet w

note.en: Clarified a viral discussion about Mamba-2 vs. gated delta networks (GDN), disputing a claim that Mamba-2 was being framed as superior to GDN.
note.zh: 针对一场引发热议的讨论作出澄清，反驳有关Mamba-2被说成优于GDN（门控增量网络）的说法。

title.en: many papers have reported Mamba results inconsistent with what we found internally. we finally traced down the cause, which comes from wrong initializations in
title.zh: many papers have reported Mamba results inconsistent with what we found internally. we finally traced down the cause, which comes from wrong initializations in

note.en: Traced inconsistent Mamba benchmark results across papers to incorrect initializations in popular implementations, including Hugging Face's.
note.zh: 查明多篇论文中Mamba基准结果不一致的原因，在于包括Hugging Face在内的常用实现中初始化设置有误。

title.en: community-contributed Mamba-3-minimal code! this will be a great supplement to the official code, which should be released very soon 👀
title.zh: community-contributed Mamba-3-minimal code! this will be a great supplement to the official code, which should be released very soon 👀

note.en: Highlighted community-contributed Mamba-3-minimal code as a useful supplement ahead of the official code release.
note.zh: 指出社区贡献的Mamba-3-minimal代码是官方代码发布前的有益补充。

title.en: normal hybrid models place attention layers in a fixed pattern, such as every 3-4 layers. but we previously showed that the main role of attention in hybrid mod
title.zh: normal hybrid models place attention layers in a fixed pattern, such as every 3-4 layers. but we previously showed that the main role of attention in hybrid mod

note.en: Discussed how attention layers in hybrid models don't need a fixed placement pattern, building on prior findings about the specific role attention heads play in such models.
note.zh: 探讨混合模型中的注意力层无需固定排布模式，并结合此前关于注意力头在此类模型中具体作用的研究结论。

title.en: Retrieval-Aware Distillation for Transformer-SSM Hybrids
title.zh: Retrieval-Aware Distillation for Transformer-SSM Hybrids

note.en: Distillation recipe that preserves retrieval-capable attention heads when converting transformers into SSM hybrids; Gu is senior author.
note.zh: 在把 Transformer 转换为 SSM 混合模型时保留具备检索能力的注意力头的蒸馏方法，Gu 为通讯作者。

title.en: dnaHNet: A Scalable and Hierarchical Foundation Model for Genomic Sequence Learning
title.zh: dnaHNet: A Scalable and Hierarchical Foundation Model for Genomic Sequence Learning

note.en: Applies hierarchical, tokenizer-free H-Net style modeling to genomic sequences; Gu is senior author.
note.zh: 把无分词器的分层 H-Net 建模方式用于基因组序列，Gu 为通讯作者。

title.en: one question we got a lot about H-Net is how it compares to MoE. the idea is that both of them can be seen as dynamic or sparse computation methods that can adj
title.zh: one question we got a lot about H-Net is how it compares to MoE. the idea is that both of them can be seen as dynamic or sparse computation methods that can adj

note.en: Explained how H-Net's dynamic computation compares to mixture-of-experts, framing both as ways to adjust the FLOPs-to-parameter ratio.
note.zh: 解释H-Net的动态计算与专家混合（MoE）模型的比较，认为二者都是调整FLOPs与参数比例的方式。

title.en: a silly milestone but one nonetheless - 20k citations! although i don't think it's a very useful metric (i got my position at @CarnegieMellon with ~700 citation
title.zh: a silly milestone but one nonetheless - 20k citations! although i don't think it's a very useful metric (i got my position at @CarnegieMellon with ~700 citation

note.en: Marked 20,000 citations while arguing the metric is overrated, noting he got his CMU position with only about 700 citations.
note.zh: 在论文引用量突破两万之际，表示该指标被高估，并指出自己当初获得CMU教职时引用量仅约700次。

title.en: really excited to see NVIDIA continue their dedication to open source and hybrid models. still achieving great results with Mamba-2! it's been a pleasure discus
title.zh: really excited to see NVIDIA continue their dedication to open source and hybrid models. still achieving great results with Mamba-2! it's been a pleasure discus

note.en: Praised NVIDIA's continued open-source work and strong results with Mamba-2 hybrids, noting an ongoing collaboration.
note.zh: 称赞NVIDIA持续的开源工作及在Mamba-2混合架构上取得的优异成果，并提及双方持续的合作。

title.en: quite belated, but we finally uploaded "ARC-AGI Without Pretraining" to arXiv (link in reply) very impressive project by @LiaoIsaac91893 when he was just a firs
title.zh: quite belated, but we finally uploaded "ARC-AGI Without Pretraining" to arXiv (link in reply) very impressive project by @LiaoIsaac91893 when he was just a firs

note.en: Announced the arXiv upload of "ARC-AGI Without Pretraining," crediting a first-year PhD student who drove the project.
note.zh: 宣布论文《ARC-AGI Without Pretraining》上传arXiv，并称赞由一名一年级博士生主导完成该项目。

title.en: ARC-AGI Without Pretraining
title.zh: ARC-AGI Without Pretraining

note.en: Two-author paper showing ARC-AGI puzzles can be solved by inference-time compression with no pretraining; Gu is senior author.
note.zh: 两人合作的论文，表明无需预训练、仅靠推理时的压缩即可求解 ARC-AGI 谜题，Gu 为通讯作者。

title.en: Joint Distillation for Fast Likelihood Evaluation and Sampling in Flow-based Models
title.zh: Joint Distillation for Fast Likelihood Evaluation and Sampling in Flow-based Models

note.en: Distillation method giving flow-based generative models both fast sampling and fast likelihood evaluation; Gu is a co-author.
note.zh: 让流式生成模型同时具备快速采样与快速似然计算的蒸馏方法，Gu 为共同作者。

title.en: love to see it - ongoing community effort makes deploying recurrent models (mamba, deltanet, other linear attention hybrids) easier than ever to realize their i
title.zh: love to see it - ongoing community effort makes deploying recurrent models (mamba, deltanet, other linear attention hybrids) easier than ever to realize their i

note.en: Welcomed community efforts making recurrent models like Mamba and DeltaNet easier to deploy, unlocking their inference throughput advantages.
note.zh: 欢迎社区努力使Mamba、DeltaNet等循环模型更易部署，从而释放其推理吞吐量方面的优势。

title.en: immensely proud of the team for our best model yet. grateful to be able to work with such a strong team of researchers who are always curious and willing to exp
title.zh: immensely proud of the team for our best model yet. grateful to be able to work with such a strong team of researchers who are always curious and willing to exp

note.en: Said Cartesia shipped its best model yet, crediting the research team's willingness to explore unconventional approaches.
note.zh: 表示Cartesia推出了迄今最好的模型，并称赞研究团队勇于探索非常规方法。

title.en: at the tokenizer workshop panel at ICML, i made an offhand joke about eventually going to raw pixels being the way, i didn't press it too hard bc the pitchforks
title.zh: at the tokenizer workshop panel at ICML, i made an offhand joke about eventually going to raw pixels being the way, i didn't press it too hard bc the pitchforks

note.en: Recounted a joke made at an ICML tokenizer workshop panel about eventually moving to raw pixels, amid the debate sparked by H-Net.
note.zh: 回顾在ICML分词器研讨会panel上开的一个关于最终转向原始像素的玩笑，当时H-Net引发的争论正激烈。

title.en: I really like this research direction! For a long time, I've been talking about the "brain vs. database" analogy of SSMs vs Transformers. An extension of this t
title.zh: I really like this research direction! For a long time, I've been talking about the "brain vs. database" analogy of SSMs vs Transformers. An extension of this t

note.en: Elaborated on his long-standing "brain vs. database" analogy for comparing SSMs and Transformers, extending it further.
note.zh: 进一步阐述他一直以来用来比较SSM与Transformer的“大脑对数据库”类比。

title.en: Chimera: State Space Models Beyond Sequences
title.zh: Chimera: State Space Models Beyond Sequences

note.en: Extends state-space models from sequences to images and graphs through structured mixers; Gu is senior author.
note.zh: 通过结构化混合算子把状态空间模型从序列推广到图像与图数据，Gu 为通讯作者。

title.en: really glad to see so much effort being put into furthering understanding of H-Nets! the main caveat with these results is the scale: the blog's experiments go
title.zh: really glad to see so much effort being put into furthering understanding of H-Nets! the main caveat with these results is the scale: the blog's experiments go

note.en: Welcomed efforts to better understand H-Nets but cautioned that the experiments only reach a scale about 1000x smaller than needed to be conclusive.
note.zh: 欢迎深入理解H-Net的研究工作，但提醒相关实验规模比得出结论所需的规模小约1000倍。

title.en: Autoregressive Universal Video Segmentation Model
title.zh: Autoregressive Universal Video Segmentation Model

note.en: NVIDIA collaboration applying autoregressive sequence modeling to unprompted video segmentation; Gu is a co-author.
note.zh: 与 NVIDIA 合作，把自回归序列建模用于无提示的视频分割，Gu 为共同作者。

title.en: a common belief is that Transformers scale well because of less inductive bias, when it actually does have specific inductive biases. we developed H-Nets not to
title.zh: a common belief is that Transformers scale well because of less inductive bias, when it actually does have specific inductive biases. we developed H-Nets not to

note.en: Argued Transformers do have specific inductive biases despite common belief otherwise, explaining H-Nets were developed for reasons beyond fixing tokenization.
note.zh: 反驳普遍认为“Transformer几乎没有归纳偏置”的看法，并说明开发H-Net的初衷不仅是为了解决分词问题。

title.en: H-Nets - the Future
title.zh: H-Nets - the Future

note.en: Argues that hierarchical networks learning their own chunking can replace fixed tokenisation in sequence models.
note.zh: 论证让分层网络自行学习分块方式，可以取代序列模型中固定的分词步骤。

title.en: H-Nets - the Past
title.zh: H-Nets - the Past

note.en: Companion post tracing the line of ideas that led to H-Nets, from earlier state-space and hierarchical models.
note.zh: 配套文章，回溯从早期状态空间模型与分层模型一路通向 H-Nets 的思想脉络。

title.en: Dynamic Chunking for End-to-End Hierarchical Sequence Modeling
title.zh: Dynamic Chunking for End-to-End Hierarchical Sequence Modeling

note.en: H-Net, which learns its own chunking end to end and removes the need for a tokenizer; Gu is senior author.
note.zh: 提出 H-Net，端到端学习分块方式，从而不再需要分词器，Gu 为通讯作者。

title.en: On the Tradeoffs of SSMs and Transformers
title.zh: On the Tradeoffs of SSMs and Transformers

note.en: His widely read essay on what state-space models and attention each buy you, and why he considers tokenisation a crutch.
note.zh: 他流传甚广的一篇文章，剖析状态空间模型与注意力机制各自的取舍，并指出分词只是一根拐杖。

title.en: Understanding and Improving Length Generalization in Recurrent Models
title.zh: Understanding and Improving Length Generalization in Recurrent Models

note.en: Explains why recurrent models fail on sequences longer than they were trained on, and what fixes the failure.
note.zh: 解释循环模型为何在超出训练长度的序列上失效，以及如何修正这一问题。

title.en: Understanding the Skill Gap in Recurrent Language Models: The Role of the Gather-and-Aggregate Mechanism
title.zh: Understanding the Skill Gap in Recurrent Language Models: The Role of the Gather-and-Aggregate Mechanism

note.en: Traces the recall weakness of recurrent language models to a small gather-and-aggregate mechanism; Gu is senior author.
note.zh: 把循环语言模型在检索上的短板追溯到少数收集-聚合机制，Gu 为通讯作者。

title.en: Lyra: An Efficient and Expressive Subquadratic Architecture for Modeling Biological Sequences
title.zh: Lyra: An Efficient and Expressive Subquadratic Architecture for Modeling Biological Sequences

note.en: Subquadratic architecture for biological sequence modeling; Gu is a co-author.
note.zh: 面向生物序列建模的次二次架构，Gu 为共同作者。

title.en: Thinking Slow, Fast: Scaling Inference Compute with Distilled Reasoners
title.zh: Thinking Slow, Fast: Scaling Inference Compute with Distilled Reasoners

note.en: Distills transformer reasoners into recurrent models so test-time compute scaling stays cheap; Gu is a co-author.
note.zh: 把 Transformer 推理模型蒸馏到循环架构，使测试时计算的扩展更廉价，Gu 为共同作者。

title.en: Llamba: Scaling Distilled Recurrent Models for Efficient Language Processing
title.zh: Llamba: Scaling Distilled Recurrent Models for Efficient Language Processing

note.en: Distills Llama-3.x into the Mamba architecture, a Cartesia-linked line of efficient recurrent models; Gu is senior author.
note.zh: 把 Llama-3.x 蒸馏为 Mamba 架构的高效循环模型系列，与 Cartesia 一脉相承，Gu 为通讯作者。

title.en: HybriDNA: A Hybrid Transformer-Mamba2 Long-Range DNA Language Model
title.zh: HybriDNA: A Hybrid Transformer-Mamba2 Long-Range DNA Language Model

note.en: Hybrid transformer-Mamba2 DNA language model for long genomic sequences; Gu is a co-author.
note.zh: 面向长基因组序列的 Transformer-Mamba2 混合 DNA 语言模型，Gu 为共同作者。

title.en: On the Benefits of Memory for Modeling Time-Dependent PDEs
title.zh: On the Benefits of Memory for Modeling Time-Dependent PDEs

note.en: Shows non-Markovian memory improves neural solvers for time-dependent PDEs; Gu is a co-author.
note.zh: 表明引入非马尔可夫记忆能改善时变偏微分方程的神经求解器，Gu 为共同作者。

title.en: Cross-Architecture Distillation Part I - The MOHAWK Framework
title.zh: Cross-Architecture Distillation Part I - The MOHAWK Framework

note.en: Introduces MOHAWK, a framework for distilling a pretrained Transformer into a Mamba-style recurrent model.
note.zh: 介绍 MOHAWK 框架：把已预训练的 Transformer 蒸馏成 Mamba 式的循环模型。

title.en: Cross-Architecture Distillation Part II - Phi-Mamba-1.5B Model and Training Laws
title.zh: Cross-Architecture Distillation Part II - Phi-Mamba-1.5B Model and Training Laws

note.en: Second part of the distillation series, reporting the Phi-Mamba-1.5B model and the training laws that govern cross-architecture distillation.
note.zh: 蒸馏系列的第二部分，公布 Phi-Mamba-1.5B 模型以及跨架构蒸馏所遵循的训练规律。

title.en: Transformers to SSMs: Distilling Quadratic Knowledge to Subquadratic Models
title.zh: Transformers to SSMs: Distilling Quadratic Knowledge to Subquadratic Models

note.en: MOHAWK, a method for distilling pretrained transformers into subquadratic state-space models; Gu is senior author.
note.zh: MOHAWK 方法，把预训练 Transformer 蒸馏为次二次的状态空间模型，Gu 为通讯作者。

title.en: Mamba, Mamba-2 and Post-Transformer Architectures for Generative AI with Albert Gu
title.zh: Mamba, Mamba-2 and Post-Transformer Architectures for Generative AI with Albert Gu

posts.source: The TWIML AI Podcast (formerly This We…

note.en: Long-form interview on Mamba, Mamba-2 and where post-Transformer architectures go next.
note.zh: 长篇访谈，谈 Mamba、Mamba-2 以及后 Transformer 架构的下一步方向。

title.en: Hydra: Bidirectional State Space Models Through Generalized Matrix Mixers
title.zh: Hydra: Bidirectional State Space Models Through Generalized Matrix Mixers

note.en: Bidirectional state-space model derived from a unifying matrix-mixer view of sequence models; Gu is senior author.
note.zh: 从统一的矩阵混合视角推导出的双向状态空间模型，Gu 为通讯作者。

title.en: The State Space Model Revolution, with Albert Gu
title.zh: The State Space Model Revolution, with Albert Gu

note.en: Interview covering the state-space model line of work and the founding of Cartesia.
note.zh: 访谈，围绕状态空间模型这一研究路线以及 Cartesia 的创立展开。

title.en: State Space Models and Real-time Intelligence with Karan Goel and Albert Gu from Cartesia
title.zh: State Space Models and Real-time Intelligence with Karan Goel and Albert Gu from Cartesia

note.en: Appears with Cartesia co-founder Karan Goel to discuss state-space models and real-time voice systems.
note.zh: 与 Cartesia 联合创始人 Karan Goel 一同出镜，讨论状态空间模型与实时语音系统。

title.en: An Empirical Study of Mamba-based Language Models
title.zh: An Empirical Study of Mamba-based Language Models

note.en: NVIDIA-led 8B-scale comparison of Mamba, hybrid and transformer language models; Gu is a co-author.
note.zh: 由 NVIDIA 主导的 8B 规模对比研究，比较 Mamba、混合架构与 Transformer 语言模型，Gu 为共同作者。

title.en: Transformers are SSMs: Generalized Models and Efficient Algorithms Through Structured State Space Duality
title.zh: Transformers are SSMs: Generalized Models and Efficient Algorithms Through Structured State Space Duality

note.en: The Mamba-2 paper, establishing a structured state space duality between attention and SSMs; written with Tri Dao.
note.zh: Mamba-2 论文，建立注意力与状态空间模型之间的结构化对偶关系，由 Gu 与 Tri Dao 合著。

title.en: Caduceus: Bi-Directional Equivariant Long-Range DNA Sequence Modeling
title.zh: Caduceus: Bi-Directional Equivariant Long-Range DNA Sequence Modeling

note.en: Bidirectional, reverse-complement-equivariant DNA sequence model built on Mamba; Gu is a co-author.
note.zh: 基于 Mamba 的双向、反向互补等变 DNA 序列模型，Gu 为共同作者。

title.en: Griffin: Mixing Gated Linear Recurrences with Local Attention for Efficient Language Models
title.zh: Griffin: Mixing Gated Linear Recurrences with Local Attention for Efficient Language Models

note.en: DeepMind's Hawk and Griffin architectures mixing gated linear recurrences with local attention; Gu is a co-author.
note.zh: DeepMind 的 Hawk 与 Griffin 架构，把门控线性循环与局部注意力结合，Gu 为共同作者。

title.en: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
title.zh: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces

note.en: The original Mamba paper introducing selective state spaces, Gu's best-known work and the basis for Cartesia's models.
note.zh: Mamba 原始论文，提出选择性状态空间，是 Gu 最知名的工作，也是 Cartesia 模型的基础。

title.en: Augmenting conformers with structured state-space sequence models for online speech recognition
title.zh: Augmenting conformers with structured state-space sequence models for online speech recognition

note.en: Google collaboration adding structured state-space layers to conformer encoders for streaming speech recognition; Gu is a co-author.
note.zh: 与 Google 合作，在 conformer 编码器中加入结构化状态空间层以支持流式语音识别，Gu 为共同作者。

title.en: Resurrecting Recurrent Neural Networks for Long Sequences
title.zh: Resurrecting Recurrent Neural Networks for Long Sequences

note.en: DeepMind paper showing carefully initialized linear RNNs can match deep state-space models on long sequences; Gu is a co-author.
note.zh: DeepMind 论文，表明精心初始化的线性 RNN 在长序列上可媲美深度状态空间模型，Gu 为共同作者。
